items.text: Needed a place to stay just for the night  before a weekend camp at Linville. Great place to stop after a camp trip, there is access to a washer, dryer, shower, and full kitchen. Cool, unique vibe to the place. The hosts were very kind and hospitable with minimal interaction.

I absolutely loved this apartment. It was so incredible and beyond the pictures. Tania is so sweet and friendly. She is wonderful. There are three flights of stairs but she helped us with our luggage with a smile on her face. She gave us all the details we needed and had great communication. The apartment is super clean and gorgeous. The kitchen is top of the line with all the high end pots & pans & cutlery and it is just set up magnificently. She also has a washer & dryer which is super great. The location is where the main attractions are so get ready for daily excitement and by evening it is so quiet and she has double windows with wood & glass so you don't hear a thing and you sleep so well. This was my favorite apartment it is a must stay. I was delighted!! Tania is very professional  5 Star all the way! I want to go back next year.

From the moment I arrived at Mt Martha Country Lane, I felt very relaxed and comfortable. It’s a great spot for a single traveller and can be enjoyed at any season. It is very cosy and the provisions make it feel very homely. It’s private, peaceful and the access to the gate and back garden is fantastic. I would happily revisit this gorgeous cottage.
Perfect location, so close to all the buzz around Shoreditch but the street is very quiet and peaceful.

Karina es una anfitriona muy amable, responde a nuestros mensajes extremadamente rápido. El departamento es muy hermoso, tiene calefactores y las habitaciones son óptimas. El equipo de conserjería es muy gentil y acogedor. Debajo del edificio hay una panadería, lo cual fue estupendo, porque facilitó mucho nuestro desayuno. Además, el departamento está a 10-15 minutos a pie del Sky Costanera y tiene una estación de metro literalmente enfrente. Recomiendo el departamento de Karina con la seguridad de que tendrán una estadía tan agradable como la que nosotros tuvimos.

I have nothing but great things to say about my stay at Yumi’s Airbnb. It's in a convenient location (so close to Alki Beach), with a clean and spacious room with an attached bathroom, in a quiet neighborhood. They also offer free coffee, available cookware, and silverware. Most importantly, Yumi and her cohosts are incredibly friendly and supportive. I ended up extending my stay twice, and Yumi made it hassle-free! Thank you so much!

Apartment is in a fantastic area in CBD great restaurants within walking distance grocery store underneath where unit is located so easy to get supplies  Would definitely stay here again  Peter the host was very responsive when asked any questions

El lugar es super cómodo por lo que te sientes como en casa, de muy fácil acceso ya que esta a solo un par de cuadras del metro, avenida santa fe etc. Los restaurantes que se encuentran alrededor son muy buenos también. Es un apart hotel que te entrega la confianza en cuanto a seguridad y tranquilidad. Lo disfrutamos bastante. Por otro lado llana siempre estuvo muy atenta a lo que necesitáramos.Muchas gracias por todo!

Jacky and Tony provided outstanding hospitality at their delightful home last weekend. We loved the house, the country air and scenery, and really appreciated the extra efforts from coming home to a pre-lit fire place, to a freshly baked cake and great advice on local attractions. The house is lovely with everything you could want as well as great views of farmland and the valley and mountains. We enjoyed walking around the property and playing with the dogs too. The super host status is well earned!

We absolutely loved this place!! So cozy and immaculate!!  We had our 2 dogs and they loved it too!! So Open and roomy. We never had a problem finding a parking along the street. Would not hesitate to stay here again.

The place was super cute and cozy. Very easy to find and convenient to transportation. It was was easy and simple to catch one and be in the centre downtown. I had all the privacy which was really nice . It’s was very comfortable to stay . It did get loud sometimes but that didn’t bother me personally.
James was great. I would recommend this place to my family and friends. Thank You for for being flexible and we loved the space super cute.
What’s great condo place to stay for the weekend .  Right on the beach easy access and close to my favorite spots in the north shore.  Will keep this place in mind for sure for next time .

We loved everything about this ADU! Tiffany was an excellent and attentive host. She kept in touch to see if we had any needs. There is a binder with helpful instructions and information. The selection of coffees, teas and extras were varied and perfect! Even had Nespresso pods! The unit was spotless and sooo comfy!  Neighborhood is peaceful and friendly with restaurants, bars and cafes to suit pretty much anyone's taste. Fremont St is a block away so make sure to visit the Beaumont Market, Grand Central Bakery Cafe, Pip's Donuts and the Hi-Top Tavern. The Little Griddle fills  up quickly because it's small but popular.  So many other places we looked at were in people's basement set up as an apartment. We're very glad we chose this place! You will too!
Great location, just far enough from the downtown to be quiet, but a quick ride to anywhere.  I would stay here again!
Mary is really quick at keeping in touch and a very nice host. She advised us on where to find weird stuff (vegetable seeds :P) and kept our luggage for the day after we had checked out. Great host!
Very nice place to stay in and weidong was always helpful and responsive when we needed help with anything

This townhouse was so wonderful for our family. We were able to see everything on the island and leave the chaos of the city and go back to a peaceful paradise. We were able to make several meals with the grill and full kitchen each day and still enjoy food and culture while out. The hot tub and swimming pool are clean and relaxing. Bonnie and Mathew provided many of the necessities such as a beach umbrella, chairs, towels, cooler and even sunscreen if needed. The community is absolutely gorgeous and we even spent a day walking around the Disney resort and had shaved ice. The lagoons are peaceful and family friendly, overall this home away from home really made our experience the best it could be.

Gentilezza e ospitalità non sono solo elementi distintivi di questo  B&B bensì una piccola parte dei tanti ingredienti di qualità che rendono il soggiorno al Meraki un “esperienza” nell’eccellenza. La struttura nuova e ben tenuta,  gli arredi freschi e di buon gusto, la pulizia ineccepibile, l’accoglienza e le piccole attenzioni che fanno proprio sentire di essere a casa. Ogni cosa al suo posto a sottolineare equilibrio e raffinata essenzialità, davvero nessuna imperfezione. Complimenti a Samuele e congratulazioni a chi, dopo di noi, potrà approfittare della piacevole ospitalità del Meraki!
Great location and fantastic value for the price. The host was really responsive. Will definitely be rebooking

Nicolas' place is unbelievable and became one of the more memorable parts of my fantastic trip to Buenos Aires. I was traveling in Argentina and Brazil with my mom for a couple of weeks. After staying in cramped hotel rooms at our first few stops Nicolas' spacious apartment was quite a breath of fresh air. We the unique feel that this apartment has from the historic building exterior to the tall ceilings to the art and decor in all of the rooms. It was really nice to sit in the living room or dining room in the morning looking out the huge windows at Avenida de Mayo and Plaza del Congresso. There is a Subte station right outside the front door which we used a few times when we could and we found the area the apartment was in quite nice and were able to walk to restaurants and even to a nearby grocery store. I had an unforgettable trip to Buenos Aires and I hope to return soon, and when I do I will without a doubt try to stay at Nicolas' place again!

I would not dare give this place a 5*4*3*or two*I really did not want to give one but this is my only option if I can give zeros that’s what it deserves I’m not sure why others gave it a 5. I know the host ask us to do this after our stay to give a five star. However I’m honest this place doesn’t deserve that at all. It’s so much water damage all through the entire Units The beds squeak, so bad and very uncomfortable. We have killed spiders and roaches. The back door leverage is locking you in there like you’re in prison.The host was unresponsive for a whole day and told me as a guess she was at a wedding all day, she turned off her phone.Wow” the very first night I had to wait on her to come to get in because The locks did not work so at 2am  in the morning the upstairs tenets were smoking weed in the front door,drinking and partying and it was 2 am . She came 20 minutes later to let me in she then took a hour to fix the lock. I hope this video shows enough

From the moment we arrived Tania was waiting to greet us with a friendly smile and enthusiasm to show us around the apartment. We got the immediate warm and fuzzy feeling. It was greatly appreciated that she had a complimentary bottle of milk, water and apple juice in the fridge as well as toast and spread for our mornings complete with an array of teas and coffee. This was an exceptionally nice touch. The beds were very comfortable and the restroom had q-tips, soap, towels and everything you can need to freshen up. All in all it really felt like coming home after a long day of walking and sightseeing. Tania even said her farewells at check out and hoped we'd return some day in the future. The apartment is a bit a way from the center of rome but in my opinion it's better than dealing with the crowded traffic in the morning. Taking the bus and metro was very easy. She even showed us how to take the bus on the maps she had (very useful). I highly recommend this cozy place away from the craziness that is the center of Rome.

Kelly’s condo was so cozy and cute! I loved how easy it was to cook meals. Everything you need is in the kitchen to make whatever you want. There are towels and chairs to take to the beach as well as a comfy bed in the bedroom. The salt water pool on the ocean was wonderful and it was really nice to eat dinner and watch the sun set over the ocean. Overall we really enjoyed our time here and we would definitely stay here again.

My husband and I stayed at this condo with our 2 and 5 year old daughters. It’s very spacious and worked good for our family. The kitchen is fully equipped with all you need to cook. The 2 bathrooms are also spacious and we loved the shower heads. The pack and play was missing when we arrived and we planned to use it. I contacted the host and was provided one to use within an hour. There were also plenty of beach chairs and beach towels available for use.  Overall the place has pro and cons but the cons were things outside of the owners control. The buildings surrounding create a wind tunnel so it’s very windy in the pool area and while walking down to the beach. Once you get to the beach it’s very pleasant. Also, there was a strong marijuana smell on our floor multiple times.

The best of the best!  Beds were comfortable, the apartment was clean, all the necessary house essentials were there.  The location is unbeatable and even in the end of December, it was pleasantly warm inside.  Hosts were courteous and extremely flexible.   Can’t give enough positives about our experience!

First time booking with airbnb and Barbara set the bar high! She was flexible with our flight change, reponded within the hour. The space alone was more than we expected. Clean, cozy, spacious! All major tourist attractions were close by. Surrounding area felt safe as well.

Me and my husband had a great stay here! It was clean, in a good neighborhood and Andi responded quickly to all messages. We definatly would stay here again. The only down fall was the internet connection wasn't great our phones connected but my lap top had trouble so I ended up going to the library around the corner from Andis to take a test. Over all great place to stay!
Lovely stay at Rohin's apartment. Very central location in Mayfair but in a quiet street. The apartment is exactly as appears in the picture and well-equipped.

Ellie’s home is spotless and well appointed. There were plenty of super soft towels and comfy pillows. It was a great place to land after our adventurous and tiresome days. She left water for us in the fridge and an assortment of teas and coffees! I couldn’t have made it without the maps provided! Everything was comfy and inviting.

Giusi is an incredibly amazing host. Communication was always on time and she has been incredibly helpful, even before we arrived. The apartment is cosy, romantic, and strategically located for sightseeing spots and restaurants. Whilst we were here, Palermo hosted the annual Heritage Event, and Giusi’s apartment building is one of the heritage sites. There is a jazzy hippy cafe/bar just outside of the apartment’s courtyard, and it sits a waltz away from the Quattro Canti where the nightlife begins. We were celebrating our anniversary and found Giusi’s place highly suitable for couples who likes a cosy private time to themselves, but also within proximity to enjoy a bit of city life and being a tourist. We highly recommend Giusi’s hospitality and apartment to anyone wishing to share our experience!

El depto de Martín y Nicole súper recomendable, todo en orden , muy practico con lo necesario para una estadía corta en la ciudad , la ubicación privilegiada, todo mano , el barrio con ese plus de estar cerca y a la vez tranquilo, la atención de Nicole para con nosotros estupenda , muy flexible y humana , a pesar de tener un próximo huésped nos permitió quedarnos más de la cuenta debido a nuestro vuelo fuera de horario , sin dudas volveremos, chicos una vez más gracias!
The place is exactly in the pics, very comfortable, clean and worth every penny also Abbe is great at  communicating. Will definitely book again.

A wonderful large flat right in the middle of Islington. If you want a real London experience, I cannot recommend this flat more. It’s located on a gorgeous square in one of my favourite parts of London, has its own garden and a fully stocked kitchen, living room and bedroom.... you could even have friends for dinner in there! It’s stunning, with wonderful stylish touches throughout and we would absolutely love to come back.

Staying at Giuseppe’s villa was an amazing bonus to our holiday! He was so welcoming and helpful, when we arrived he gave us a map showing us all the local shops, bakeries etc. He also put us in contact with his friend who is a taxi driver so we were able to go into Palermo City a couple of times! The villa itself is beautiful, it was one of the only villas we saw that came with it’s own private pool to ourselves so that was a definite plus. There’s lots to do with two kitchens, multiple bars, piano and a pool table. It’s a 15 minute walk from the beach, 5 minutes to the supermarket, pharmacy, bakery etc.  We did hear the dogs mentioned in other reviews, however yard dogs are very common in Sicily and Italy especially in expensive neighbourhoods like this one, so it didn’t bother us at all. In fact, other than the occasional barking it was very peaceful and quiet with the villa being away from main roads!  Thank you so much for hosting is Giuseppe! We were spoilt with such a beautiful villa all to ourselves as a couple so would love to visit again in the future with friends!

Un tres agréable séjour dans l'appartement de Raffaele, tres propre et moderne, conforme aux photos. La clim était tres agréable, surtout au mois d'aout. Raffaele a su etre reactif lorsque nous en avions besoin et nous a reservé un tres bon accueil.  Le seul bemol est la localisation. Meme s'il y a une gare de train à 5min de l'appartement, nous perdions beaucoup de temps dans les transports pour rejoindre la côte amalfitaine ou Pompei (la ligne était en plus en travaux... ) L'appartement est cependant très bien situé pour aller récupérer un bateau a Pozzuoli pour visiter Procida et Ischia.

The look/layout of the apartment matched exactly the pictures posted in the Listing, very clean and modern. I was slightly disappointed that there was only 1 TV in the unit (in the bedroom), but that’s a minor quibble. I loved the fact that the unit contained two bathrooms, one near the entry and one located in the bedroom (w/ shower). I will mention that bed is very firm, which I actually liked because I have Sciatica in my lower back. I loved the location of this building it’s on a very quiet block near the end, super private and safe. In fact, the whole surrounding area seemed very safe to me, had no trepidations about walking around late at night (although I am 6’3, YMMV).  The area has tons of Banks and ATMs; you’re always just a stone throw away from one. There are also tons of restaurants and pharmacies within walking distance.  Another big plus about this property is that there’s no extra cost for guests. I’m very happy that I picked this area to stay in.  Sergio was very responsive to my text messages via Airbnb, he even provided me his WhatsApp number for even quicker responses.  The onsite Doormen were quick and attentive, great group of guys. If I visit Bogota again thi

The apartment was terrific! Spacious, comfortable and perfectly located. Meighan as decorated it so nicely with interesting items obviously culled from travels around the world. Information on everything and anything possible to do in the neighborhood, and all around Chicago was at our fingertips. Our only regret was that we didn't have more days so we could just hang out at the apartment! We'd definitely return.
We had a really good time! The location of the apartment is perfect, very central. Antonio was very helpful and easy to communicate with!

Chris & his team made me feel like home. They accommodated my request to leave the bag before check-in time. So I could have a peaceful trip around. The location is at the heart of all places that u plan to visit during your stay. Also they went above and beyond in fulfilling my request even though they don’t usually do it for everyone. All in all I would highly recommend the place. Great parking & security.

We absolutely loved our time here. Everything looked just like the photos but it’s not until you get there you realise that you are actually in heaven! Haha! We couldn’t get enough of just sitting on the balcony and taking in the scenery - it was breathtaking! The house was great, had everything we needed for a group of 7. Everyone commented on how comfortable the beds were, the lounge was also a great size for us to watch movies as it rained on and off one day. All in all it was a wonderful experience and we plan on making it an annual trip 👌🏽 thanks for everything Rachel 🙏🏽😊
espaço bastante aconchegante e condiz com a fotos do anúncio. A localização é perfeita, próximo à praia e com  comércio ao redor do prédio.

We absolutely loved our stay. Everything was perfect. I can’t emphasize enough what a lovely flat it is. My tweens asked if we could just go back to Mayfair and continue our stay! We would love to visit again.  Jacob met us at the home and gave us a tour. The home is historic and beautifully decorated. The location really does feel like it is in the heart of London. We could easily have spent a week exploring.

We loved this place. Great location. It’s def in the more conservative part of town but easily accessible to the hagia Sofia and the sites. Right next to a market and  The restaurant right across the way is great and the staff is amazing at the front.  We loved the free coffee and biscuits at the front 24/7 esp when coming home after a big night.  Such a cute place, redone semi recently by the looks of it. Super quiet despite having a 1st floor room. Only thing was- we wished the beds were a bit more comfortable. Only thing we’d change. other than that- great place to experience Istanbul!

The checkin process was a breeze! Thomas and Simone sent an awesome video that was very informative specific to parking, amenities, and the surrounding area. The studio had literally every thing you may ever need from essential toiletries to chargers to champagne. It was very convenient to have the laundry machines in the studio. Thomas was very responsive and helpful. The view on a sunny day is very beautiful!!
Great little spot for a stop over. Cute wee unit. Very clean, nicely furnished. We were well surprised by the thoughtful supplied breakfast goodies. Thanks

I just spent a marvellous time in the apartment of Emilce. The location is great: you have everything around the corner, shops, cafés, very nice restaurants (the Voulez-bar at the corner and the restaurant/café of the Evita Museum just two blocks away were my favorite ones), parks, public transportation. The house is very quiet and safe and I felt well in any moment. It's great you have a washing machine & dryer in the first floor. Emilce was so friendly and helpful at any moment, whenever I had questions or doubts she answered whithin hours and she was a great help. In the apartment you can feel at home at once, it has lots of light and a wonderful balcony. I would really like to come again!!! Thank you, dear Emilce!!!!

Wow!  What a fantastic apartment.  Spotless, light and airy.  Bed big and comfortable.  Air conditioning in both the living room and bedroom which was a godsend.  We were met by our host who helped us with our heavy suitcase.  Explained everything about the apartment.  Everything was provided ie washing up liquid, dish cloths etc.  washing powder/conditioner for the washing machine which was a bonus.  They kindly stocked the fridge with ham, cheese, butter, bread, water, wine and even homemade honey.  The bathroom was well stocked with shampoo, shower gel etc.  hairdryer. Just amazing.  It’s a quiet apartment but just a short walk to the lovely tavernas.  The beach is a 5m walk away.  An umbrella and two padded beds €10 for the day.  The fabulous Andreas looked after us.  The apartment doesn’t have a pool so we used the Pallatium apartments pool.  Spotlessly clean lovely people who own it.  Communication throughout was fab.  100% return to this lovely apartment. Fantastic!

Beautiful apartment in a very convenient location. Thalie was very helpful in guiding us around this completely unknown city. Very warm and hospitable person, with suggestions for any requirement.  Would definitely recommend the place.

A peaceful location, so close to Hastings Street in a beautifully appointed apartment. Loved the keyless entry and the quick walk down the well lit pathway via about 200+ steps to the restaurants and beach. Definitely stay again.
